scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) – Artiste’s Pension
description:
The Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang (CMAT) scheme is a welfare initiative launched by the Government of Manipur. 

This scheme was officially launched on 29th October 2017. 

The primary objective of CMAT is to provide financial assistance to artists in Manipur. 

The scheme aims to support those who have contributed significantly to the cultural and artistic heritage of the state. 

The pension provided under this scheme is intended for artists who are aged 60 years and above. 

The financial assistance is set at INR 5,000 per month. 

This amount is aimed at ensuring that senior artists can sustain themselves in their old age. 

The scheme specifically targets artists from various fields including music, dance, drama, and fine arts. 

The eligibility criteria for this pension scheme are clearly defined. 

Applicants must be residents of Manipur. 

They must be aged 60 years or older at the time of application. 

Additionally, applicants must have a proven track record in their respective art forms. 

This includes having participated in state or national level competitions or events. 

The application process for CMAT is straightforward but requires specific documentation. 

Interested artists must fill out an application form available at designated government offices. 

They must submit proof of age such as a birth certificate or an Aadhaar card. 

Proof of artistic contribution is also required. 

This can include certificates from recognized institutions or participation in cultural events. 

Once the application is submitted, it is reviewed by a committee formed by the government. 

The committee assesses the eligibility based on the submitted documents. 

If approved, the pension amount is disbursed monthly. 

The disbursement is typically done through direct bank transfers to the beneficiaries' accounts. 

This ensures that the funds reach the artists directly without any intermediaries. 

The CMAT scheme is implemented by the Department of Art and Culture, Government of Manipur. 

For any inquiries or assistance, individuals can contact the department directly. 

The contact details for the Department of Art and Culture are available on the official government website. 

The scheme has been well-received by the artistic community in Manipur. 

As of 2023, it has benefited over 1,000 artists across various disciplines. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 6 crores for the CMAT scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting the arts and culture sector. 

The scheme also aims to preserve and promote the rich cultural heritage of Manipur. 

In addition to the pension, the government organizes workshops and training sessions for artists. 

These initiatives are designed to enhance the skills of emerging artists in the state. 

The CMAT scheme is part of a broader strategy to uplift the socio-economic status of artists. 

It recognizes the challenges faced by artists in sustaining their livelihoods. 

The scheme also encourages younger generations to pursue careers in the arts. 

By providing financial support to senior artists, the government aims to create a stable environment for cultural expression. 

The CMAT scheme is a significant step towards recognizing the contributions of artists to society. 

It also highlights the importance of cultural preservation in a rapidly changing world. 

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and reach. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account for future improvements. 

The CMAT scheme is one of several initiatives aimed at promoting the arts in Manipur. 

Other programs include grants for art projects and scholarships for aspiring artists. 

The government is committed to fostering a vibrant cultural scene in the state. 

This commitment is evident in the continuous support for various artistic endeavors. 

The CMAT scheme stands as a testament to the value placed on cultural heritage in Manipur. 

It is a crucial lifeline for many artists who have dedicated their lives to their craft. 

The pension provided under CMAT helps alleviate financial burdens for these individuals. 

It allows them to focus on their art without the stress of economic insecurity. 

The scheme also serves to inspire younger artists to engage with their cultural roots. 

By supporting senior artists, the government is ensuring the transmission of knowledge and skills to future generations. 

The CMAT scheme is a vital component of Manipur's cultural policy. 

It reflects a deep respect for the arts and the individuals who contribute to its richness. 

Through initiatives like CMAT, the Government of Manipur aims to create a supportive ecosystem for artists. 

This ecosystem not only benefits the artists but also enriches the entire community. 

The CMAT scheme is an important recognition of the role of artists in society. 

It underscores the need for sustained support for the arts in all forms. 

The initiative is an example of how government policies can positively impact cultural sectors. 

The CMAT scheme continues to evolve with the changing needs of the artistic community. 

It is a model for other states to consider in their efforts to support artists. 

The ongoing commitment to this scheme demonstrates the Government of Manipur's dedication to cultural preservation. 

Overall, the Chief Ministergi Artistesinggi Tengbang scheme plays a crucial role in safeguarding the future of the arts in Manipur.
